# Quantum Seed-Efficient Decoupling

> Randomized Pauli frames for a qubit interacting repeatedly with a retained bath. One short private seed controls complete process error, with a matching logarithmic seed lower bound.

The authoritative model uses a finite joint qubit–bath unitary in each slot, ideal frame conjugation and corrected logical tester ports. A tester may intervene adaptively without access to frame labels or the bath. The bound compares seed-averaged process outputs with an ideal process for the same tester.
